//: Shared, non-secret developer defaults. Committed deliberately. Per-developer overrides belong in appsettings.Local.json, which is git-ignored — copy appsettings.Local.example.json to start. No secret belongs in any of these files (coding-standards CF-3).
//Persistence: Local structure only, no password. Add credentials in appsettings.Local.json, which is git-ignored. No connection is opened at startup, so this being unreachable does not stop the host.

Logging.//Console: Human-readable locally. Every other environment keeps the json formatter from appsettings.json, because NFR-OBS-001 requires logs to be machine-parseable wherever they are collected. Scopes stay enabled either way — that is enforced in code, not here, since losing them would silently drop the correlation identifier from every entry.
